variants.description: Production bilingual planner and SQLite FTS5 BM25; neutral source weights and recency; return at most 10 documents.

Empty only hub_query.CONCEPTS during production planning; entity recognition, anchor concepts, stopwords and title guards stay enabled. Unexpanded words remain literals; query grouping can consequently change.

Keep the full production FTS expression but empty QueryPlan.entities and dates, removing the post-retrieval title guard only. Query metadata/date/source filters and disabled-source checks remain enforced.
Comparator replacing the whole planner with OR of unique production search_tokens; no concept expansion, filler removal or title guards. This is not an isolated component effect.
Comparator replacing the whole planner with AND of unique production search_tokens; no concept expansion, filler removal or title guards. This is not an isolated component effect.
Change only recency_boost from 0 to the production default 0.25.
Change only recency_boost from 0 to the allowed maximum 3.
Relative to recency_1 change only half_life_days from 90 to 30; a half-life test at zero recency would be inert.
Relative to recency_1 change only half_life_days from 90 to 365.
Change only the alpha source weight from implicit 1 to 2; labels are not used to choose this weight.
Change only the alpha source weight from implicit 1 to the allowed maximum 10.
Change only the beta source weight from implicit 1 to 2.
Change only the beta source weight from implicit 1 to the allowed maximum 10.
Change only returned-document default_limit from 10 to 1; SQLite still scores all lexical matches before truncation.
Change only returned-document default_limit from 10 to 3; retrieval/quality cutoffs remain 1, 3, 5 and 10.
Change only returned-document default_limit from 10 to 5.
